scope: Pure layout mathematics and strict data admission in Node Worker; no native execution, material/ancestry, runtime or public authoring qualification

rows.name: centered 100x50x20 layout exact frozen contract and independent volume
four corners 100x50x20 have deterministic anchors and independent removal
source dimensions and depth variants 150x30x25 are recomputed
source-local translation and clockwise ordering do not change anchors
translated quarter-turn world frame retains current local coordinates
mixed-sign rotated normal requires all eight native AABB corners
actual target axial span is independent of current source extrusion depth
positive native volume is not material/ancestry proof

data.scope: Runtime must authenticate source face/feature and actual material; planner does not infer them

rows.name: offset rows and columns may reverse when all circles remain disjoint
H12 tangent boundary and exterior holes explicitly refuse
current tool-to-tool touching, overlap and coincident rows refuse
qualified profile clearance is explicit and not rounded into contact
nonrectangle, slight local skew, source holes and invalid frame refuse
stale region and invalid authored schema reject before producing tools
exact actual metric contract rejects empty, multi, invalid and missing bounds
derived tool depth and origin honor exact V3 domain bounds
unrepresentable subnormal and below-resolution radii refuse tools
detached immutable output and deterministic internal labels
outer/nested getters and toJSON never execute
strict dense/plain/finite snapshot and input work limits
